record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: CMC foliations with prescribed boundary at infinity
record.original_question: Let Λ ⊂ ∂_∞AdS^3 be the graph of a quasisymmetric homeomorphism RP^1 → RP^1, and let D be the domain of dependence defined by Λ. Is there a unique foliation of D by spacelike constant-mean-curvature surfaces with bounded principal curvatures and boundary at infinity Λ?

evidence.quote: Question 8.3. Is there a unique foliation of D by space-like, constant mean curvature surfaces with bounded principal curvature and boundary at infinity Λ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space $\mathrm{AdS}^3$, the Lorentzian model space of constant sectional curvature $-1$. Its conformal boundary at infinity $\partial_\infty \mathrm{AdS}^3$ carries a natural conformal Lorentzian structure, and the space of "lightlike directions" on this boundary is identified with two copies of $\mathbb{RP}^1$.

Let $\phi: \mathbb{RP}^1 \to \mathbb{RP}^1$ be a quasisymmetric homeomorphism, and let $\Lambda \subset \partial_\infty \mathrm{AdS}^3$ be the graph of $\phi$, viewed as an acausal topological circle in the boundary. Let $D \subset \mathrm{AdS}^3$ denote the invisible domain (domain of dependence) of $\Lambda$, i.e. the set of points $p \in \mathrm{AdS}^3$ such that every inextensible causal curve through $p$ has both endpoints on $\Lambda$.

A spacelike surface $S \subset D$ is said to have constant mean curvature (CMC) if its mean curvature is constant, and to have bounded principal curvatures if its principal curvatures are uniformly bounded on $S$. The asymptotic boundary of $S$ is $\Lambda$ if $\overline{S} \cap \partial_\infty \mathrm{AdS}^3 = \Lambda$.

Question: Does there exist a unique foliation of $D$ by spacelike CMC surfaces with bounded principal curvatures, each having asymptotic boundary equal to $\Lambda$?
artifact.status_search_result: A. Tamburelli (arXiv:1610.08867, 2016/2017) proved that for any acausal curve in $\partial_\infty \mathrm{AdS}^3$ that is the graph of a quasisymmetric homeomorphism, the domain of dependence admits a unique foliation by constant-mean-curvature surfaces with bounded second fundamental form, answering this question affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature foliation of domains of dependence in AdS_3
status_evidence.snippet: there exists a unique foliation of its domain of dependence D(Γ) by constant mean curvature surfaces with bounded second fundamental form
status_evidence.claim: Existence and uniqueness of CMC foliation with bounded principal curvatures of the domain of dependence of a quasisymmetric graph in AdS_3 is established.
